description: Free check that a stored AurelianFlo screening, batch or EDD result is authentic and unchanged. Pass the result's data and provenance exactly as returned (any edit fails verification), or pass its screening_id to verify a result stored for your account, which needs sign-in or an API key.

data.description: The data object from the result, unchanged. Give it with provenance, or give screening_id instead.

provenance.description: The provenance object from the result, unchanged. Give it with data, or give screening_id instead.

screening_id.description: The ID of a result stored for your account (a saved result, or one produced in the last 15 minutes). The server checks the stored copy. Needs sign-in or an API key.

name: screening_verify

outputSchema.description: Structured verification result: whether the signature matches the data and provenance, and why not when it does not.

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

found.description: False when a screening_id was given and no stored result matched it.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

valid.description: True when the signature matches and the result is unchanged.

verifiedFrom.description: Which stored copy was checked: saved result or recent result.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.

title: Verify Screening Result
